days.title: Visitor Centers and Historic Sites
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Nationalparkzentrum Unteres Odertal
stops.detail: The administration of the national park is located on the grounds of the castle in Criewen in the Lower Oder Valley National Park Centre.

stops.name: Nationalparkhaus
stops.detail: The national park house with an exhibition is also located there.

stops.name: Burg Stolpe
stops.detail: A little further south, on a hill, are the remains of Stolpe Castle (popularly known as the "Grützpott").

days.title: Observation and Cycling Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Turm in Mescherin
stops.detail: In the national park, cranes gather before their flight south; they can be observed, among other places, from the tower in Mescherin.

stops.name: Oder-Neiße-Radweg
stops.detail: A section of the now 465-kilometer-long Oder-Neisse Cycle Path runs along one of the dikes.
